author: Arnav
problem: Read a string S of lowercase letters. Print the letter that appears most often; if several tie, print the one that comes first alphabetically.
bug_description: The loop stops one short (len(S)-1), so the alphabetically last distinct letter is never considered.

comments.accurate: Scans the distinct letters alphabetically and keeps the first one with the highest count
comments.wrong_behavior: Picks the most frequent letter, considering every distinct letter except the alphabetically last one
comments.wrong_location: Letter scan verified; check a tie goes to the alphabetically earlier letter
